_note: The manifest recorded four homepage attempts, all status 200, all resolving to integrix.net, followed by robots, four sitemap probes and a careers-detail hop, then ten Firecrawl scrapes of integrix.net pages. The 301s themselves were not captured on the wire, so the redirect chain here is reconstructed from the recorded resolved_domain. The structural condition is what the fixture pins: every host of the requested domain lands on a different registrable domain.
